name: Ohio Valley Champion
epitaph: Planned as the promotion's own top singles title, to be crowned in an eight-man tournament once the federation reached television; no champion is recorded in the surviving documents.

name: Ohio Valley Tag Team Champions
epitaph: Planned as the promotion's own tag title, to be introduced once its tag division grew large enough to support one; no champions are recorded in the surviving documents.

name: Syndication Championship
epitaph: Planned as a title defended only on the promotion's own syndicated television broadcast, once that syndication arrived; no champion is recorded in the surviving documents.
